sources.entry: ArchiveMounter - Mounts archives like disk images.

summary.one_liner: Archive Mounter is a macOS app that mounts ZIP and RAR archive files as disk images.
summary.what_it_does: Archive Mounter is a macOS application that mounts archive files as disk images, so their contents can be browsed like a volume. It supports ZIP and RAR archives. The app can be run directly to choose an archive, or launched from Finder's "Open With" context menu. It can also be set as the default app for opening archives. Mounted volumes appear in Finder's "Computer" view according to the Q&A section. The README relies on FUSE for macOS as the underlying filesystem layer, and the build requires Xcode, cmake, and related tools.
use_cases: browse zip file contents without extracting
open rar archives on a mac
mount an archive like a disk image
set a default app for opening zip files on macOS
how_to_run: Install the latest version of FUSE for macOS
Download the latest stable release of Archive Mounter
Run the app and choose an archive to mount, or use Finder's Open With context menu
notable: Mounts ZIP and RAR archives as disk images on macOS
Integrates with Finder's Open With menu
Can be set as default app for archives
Mounted volumes shown in Finder's Computer view
caveats: Depends on FUSE for macOS, which the README says is no longer open source
Requires installing FUSE for macOS before use
Building from source needs Xcode and several tools plus system headers in /usr/include
